name: IN-03
label: Safe R

key_factors: Incumbent Stutzman running with large fundraising edge
No polls or expert ratings available
model.rationale: The R+16 district lean, Stutzman's incumbency and dominant fundraising, and Polymarket pricing near 95% Republican all point to a safe hold; Thompson's modest $136K haul offers no sign of a serious challenge.
model.watch: Any credible polling or outside spending against Stutzman would be the first signal of a competitive race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Northeast Indiana's 3rd District is solidly Republican territory, with a partisan lean of about 16 points toward the GOP. Incumbent Marlin Stutzman is running for re-election after securing his party's nomination, and he enters the general election with a large financial advantage, having raised roughly $840,000 to Democrat Kelly Thompson's $136,000, plus modest outside support on his side.

Thompson has minimal cash on hand and no visible outside backing, and no public polls or expert ratings track this race. Prediction markets give Stutzman about a 95% chance of winning. The forecast expects Stutzman to win comfortably by roughly 17 points, with the seat remaining safely in Republican hands.
